auth.description: List of authentication entries for hosts. Each entry provides a token and optional host (defaults to 'github.com'). Must be list of objects with fields: host, token, type (fixed to 'token').

aliases.description: Map of command alias names to their command strings. e.g. {pr: 'pr view'}

git_protocol.description: Protocol to use for git operations: 'ssh' or 'https'.

isatty.description: Control whether to force use of TTY for prompts. Valid values: '0' (disabled), '1' (enabled), '' (auto).
